rows.label: Console mode
rows.desc: Plays the game as on a docked Switch 2 (TV) or in handheld mode. The game picks its own resolution and detail for each mode.

rows.label: Fullscreen
rows.desc: Fills the screen with the game; F11 toggles it.

rows.label: Presentation
rows.desc: How finished frames reach the screen.

rows.label: Performance overlay
rows.desc: Frame rate in the top right corner. Full adds frame times with a graph, CPU, GPU and memory load, temperatures and the render thread's waits. F10 cycles the modes.

rows.label: Colour profile
rows.desc: Sets the four values below. Vivid: more contrast and saturation, shadows opened a little (made for OLED screens). Clarity: a little more contrast, saturation and brightness. Moving a value makes the profile Custom. The HUD changes with the picture; this menu does not.

rows.label: Brightness
rows.desc: Added to every colour; 0 leaves it.

rows.label: Contrast
rows.desc: Spreads colours away from mid-grey (above 100 %) or towards it; 100 % leaves them.

rows.label: Saturation
rows.desc: Colour strength against grey; 100 % leaves it.

rows.label: Gamma
rows.desc: Below 1 brightens dark and middle tones, above 1 darkens them; 1 leaves them.

rows.label: Internal resolution
rows.desc: Internal frame size (3D and HUD). Original uses the console tier. Higher values turn off dynamic shrink where supported. Restart.

rows.label: Anisotropic filtering
rows.desc: Minimum anisotropy on mipmapped textures (ground, lines, terrain). Game keeps the title's own setting; 8 / 16 restore angled detail lost at distance. Restart.

rows.label: Scaling to the window
rows.desc: How the picture is scaled when the window is larger than the game resolution. FSR keeps edges and detail sharper than bilinear.

rows.label: FSR sharpness
rows.desc: Sharpening after FSR scaling; 0 turns it off.

rows.label: Volume
rows.desc: Master volume of the game.

rows.label: Button layout
rows.desc: Which button is A. Nintendo: the right one, as on a Switch. Xbox: the bottom one, as labelled on an Xbox controller (cross on a PlayStation controller). Automatic picks Nintendo for controllers with Nintendo labels and Xbox for the others. Xbox prompts: A is the right one as with Nintendo, and the game shows the Xbox labels (B for A, A for B, Y for X, X for Y); the prompts change after a restart. The letters are part of the game's files, so a button you remap in Controls keeps the old letter on screen.

rows.label: Motion controls
rows.desc: Aiming with the controller's gyroscope.

rows.label: Stick dead zone
rows.desc: How far a gamepad stick moves before the game sees it. Raise it if the character or the camera moves on its own.

rows.label: Menu language
rows.desc: Language of this menu and the overlay.

rows.label: Menu theme
rows.desc: The colours of this menu. Dark: near-black with red. Light: grey and white with cyan. The game's own theme, when it has one, adds its colours and motif.

rows.label: GPU memory mode
rows.desc: How the GPU reads the game's memory. Import is fastest on discrete GPUs; Mirror copies modified ranges.
